title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
must_have: 1+ years of experience in mechanical design
text:
Graduate Engineer Trainee
Kosi Industrial Systems | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a graduate engineer trainee to join our mechanical design team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- AutoCAD
- Finite Element Analysis
- Thermodynamics
- SolidWorks
- Six Sigma
- 1+ years of experience in mechanical design

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- CNC Machining
- GD&T
- Root Cause Analysis
- PLC Programming

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive gearbox housing redesign with measurable outcomes.
- Drive fixture development with measurable outcomes.
- Drive vendor tooling programme with measurable outcomes.
